description: FDA approved TRIKAFTA (elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor, Vertex) for cystic fibrosis in patients age 12+ with at least one F508del mutation -- the first triple-combination CFTR modulator, expanding treatable CF patients to ~90%.

source.verified: Vertex investor press release + Drugs.com FDA approval history, verified 2026-09-13

knowable_time_source: FDA approval announced 2019-10-21 (Vertex press release same day). Verified 2026-09-13.
note_on_stamps: Regulatory approval: event_time == knowable_time. (Approved ahead of its PDUFA target, so the disclosure is the approval itself.)

outcome.note: Regulatory approval, not a trial-endpoint result. Recorded as the approval event, not a claim about the stock reaction.

disclosure_timing_source: FDA approval 2019-10-21 announced during/after the session (procedural).
